meta.name: implement_plan_micro
meta.description: Implement technical plans from thoughts/shared/plans with verification

copy.tagline: 自动执行技术方案并验证结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将技术方案转为可执行计划并验证
copy.tagline_en: Automate execution of technical plans with verification
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn technical plans into executable tasks with verification

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照技术计划逐步实施任务，自动读取计划、选择直接或编排模式，执行并验证每个阶段，生成交接文档，遇到问题会暂停询问用户。
howto.when: 当用户提供一份技术计划（如 thoughts/shared/plans 中的文件）并指示实施时触发。

say.note: Claude 会读取计划并开始执行。
Claude 会读取上一个交接文档并继续。
Claude 会运行自动验证并等待手动确认。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will implement technical plans step by step: automatically read the plan, select direct or orchestration mode, execute and verify each phase, generate handoff documents, and pause to ask the user when encountering issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a technical plan (e.g., from thoughts/shared/plans) and instructs implementation.

say_en.note: Claude will read the plan and start execution.
Claude will read the previous handoff and continue.
Claude will run automated verification and wait for manual confirmation.
